build_gguf_quantization_config: build a GGUFConfig quantization config to specify modules_to_not_convert for GGUF quantization
create_gguf_linear_method: create a GGUFLinearMethod to apply GGUF quantization to linear layers with fused matrix multiplication
run_fused_moe_gguf: run fused_moe_gguf to perform quantized MoE inference with top-k expert routing and activation functions
apply_gguf_embedding: apply apply_gguf_embedding to perform quantized embedding lookups with GGUF weight types
create_gguf_moe_method: create a GGUFMoEMethod to configure quantized MoE layers with w13 and w2 weight parameters
